name: PGLOBE
recent: PGLOBE 近期完成多项土地交易：以 RM238.3 million 出售柔佛 Plentong 地块予 Bridge Data Centres Malaysia IV，并获股东通过以 RM398.1 million 出售 Tanjung Kupang 两幅地块予 DayOne Data Centers Malaysia I。公司另拟以 RM127.3 million 收购 Kulai 地块，已获交易所延长提交通函期限至 2027 年 3 月 10 日。
notable: 以 RM238,317,195.60 完成出售柔佛 Plentong 约 47.86 英亩土地予 Bridge Data Centres Malaysia IV。
股东在特别股东大会通过以 RM398,107,091.20 出售 Tanjung Kupang 两幅永久地契土地予 DayOne Data Centers Malaysia I。
拟以 RM127,276,012.91 收购柔佛 Kulai 一幅永久地契土地的部分不可分割权益，交易所批准延长提交通函期限至 2027 年 3 月 10 日。

recent_en: PGLOBE recently completed several land transactions: it disposed of a Plentong, Johor parcel to Bridge Data Centres Malaysia IV for RM238.3 million, and shareholders approved the RM398.1 million disposal of two Tanjung Kupang parcels to DayOne Data Centers Malaysia I. The company also proposed a RM127.3 million acquisition of a Kulai parcel, with Bursa extending the deadline to submit the circular to 10 March 2027.
notable_en: Completed the disposal of approximately 47.86 acres in Plentong, Johor to Bridge Data Centres Malaysia IV for RM238,317,195.60.
Shareholders passed the resolution at the EGM to dispose of two freehold land parcels in Tanjung Kupang to DayOne Data Centers Malaysia I for RM398,107,091.20.
Proposed acquisition of an undivided share in a freehold land in Kulai, Johor for RM127,276,012.91; Bursa approved an extension to 10 March 2027 to submit the circular.
